runs.name: Saved baseline
runs.note: Aggregate uses native behavior: Rust sums over a 10-second window; OTel aggregates labels within each batch. Both remove host cardinality and preserve the sum, but output volume differs. Pass-Through and Filter have matching output batches. Exploratory 30-second trials; small changes may be run-to-run noise.
